name: Melissa
source: A master of camouflage and disguise, she can disguise herself as anyone she wished to be although she usually plays the role of Aeric's private maid, pretending to be a harmless rabbit. She keeps Aeric updated and purposely led the minorities so that their rebellion fits into Aeric's plan, while at the same time securing Aeric's safety.
